Controller edits / agent access
|-- MappingDocumentController manages the live document and canvas snapshot.
|   |-- It retains a history context, version, listeners and derived-node cache.
|   |-- Layout configuration and endpoint measurements update geometry.
|   `-- nodes calls canvasDisplayNodes and returns a cloned result.
|-- Public mutations converge on a shared edit path.
|   |-- applyUpdate clears temporary node correspondence before and after a batch.
|   |-- transact delegates to applyUpdate for MCP batches.
|   `-- applyOperations requires the current version and one to 100 operations.
|       `-- Operations stage changes on a cloned snapshot before publication.
|-- Content edits use the diagram service.
|   |-- Creation calls create; replacement and patches call revise.
|   |-- Patches use node and line correspondence to reanchor dependent data.
|   |   `-- Edges, jumps, folds and section ranges can be updated.
|   |-- Source-mapping edits carry the expected content hash and evidence.
|   `-- Applying an issued revision checks the expected current revision.
|-- Placement and presentation edits follow their respective models.
|   |-- Grid moves, grouping and collapse call grid update and layout functions.
|   |-- Subtree collapse updates revision-specific diagram view state.
|   |-- Floating moves update pixel geometry and switch to manual placement.
|   `-- Floating removal prunes descendants, selection and related controls.
|-- Publication reconciles dependent state before notifying listeners.
|   |-- Selection cleanup drops deleted whole instances but retains captured regions.
|   |-- Recorded scene changes reconcile connections and rebase canvas jumps.
|   |-- Recorded updates append document, view and node correspondence to history.
|   `-- Ordinary updateCanvas calls need not record history or advance the version.
|-- The page command handler routes agent requests to controllers.
|   |-- Context reads return version, name, display nodes and cloned edges.
|   |-- Apply requests call applyUpdate and cache receipts by request ID.
|   `-- Revision application uses DiagramRevisionReceiver with a sync-and-flush callback.
`-- useAgentCanvasBridge manages the browser transport lifecycle.
    |-- It registers an ephemeral canvas ID with a stable workspace identity.
    |-- Polling invokes the latest handler and posts command replies.
    |-- A bounded receipt cache excludes context reads.
    |-- Cleanup aborts polling, clears retry timers and unregisters the canvas.
    `-- A separate effect calls publishLiveCanvasSelections for the workspace.
